er_1.speaker: Narration
er_1.text: A knock at the door. The neighbour's move is in an hour and the boxes won't fit the car — could they spare a pair of hands?

er_prep.speaker: Narration
er_prep.text: There's already a full day waiting behind this favour. How to meet it?

choices.text: Pace it — help, but don't pour everything in.
Go all in — fast, thorough, no half measures.

er_into.speaker: Narration
er_into.text: Boxes everywhere, a van half-loaded, the clock ticking down. It's fiddly, tetris-like work. Who's best suited to this?

er_out_rowan.speaker: Rowan
er_out_rowan.text: He maps every box in his head and they slot together perfectly. Done early, with room to spare.

er_out_iris.speaker: Iris
er_out_iris.text: Careful and methodical. It takes a while, but nothing gets broken.

er_out_june.speaker: June
er_out_june.text: More chatting than lifting — but the neighbour leaves smiling all the same.

er_done.speaker: Narration
er_done.text: The van pulls away. A small thing, but it mattered to someone.
